import { appendFileSync, mkdirSync } from "node:fs";
import { resolve } from "node:path";
import { defineAugment, defineTool } from "auggy";
import { z } from "zod";

// Static import/factory sentinel; contains no prompts or credentials.
const directory = resolve(import.meta.dir, "../../data");
mkdirSync(directory, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
appendFileSync(resolve(directory, "import-effects.jsonl"), '{"event":"import"}\n', { mode: 0o600 });
export default function sample() {
  appendFileSync(resolve(directory, "import-effects.jsonl"), '{"event":"factory"}\n', { mode: 0o600 });
  return defineAugment({ name: "sample", tools: [defineTool({
    name: "migration_lookup", description: "Read the deterministic fixture.",
    input: z.object({ id: z.string() }),
    execute: async (input, context) => {
      if (context?.peer?.trustLevel !== "creator") return { isError: true, content: "forbidden" };
      appendFileSync(resolve(directory, "import-effects.jsonl"), '{"event":"tool"}\n', { mode: 0o600 });
      return { content: JSON.stringify({ id: input.id }) };
    },
  })] });
}
